title: Sort, Share and Count
sampleNote: SAMPLE CONTENT. Written to exercise the Sort it, Story choice and Count it screens end to end, not as World 1 teaching material. The real World 1 scripts are a later task (README section 10, phase 1); replace or delete this file then.

screens.penny: Hi again, {name}! Let's sort, share and count some coins.

screens.prompt: Put each picture in the right basket.
screens.pennyHint: Take your time, {name}. Drag a picture, or tap it and tap a basket.
screens.rightMessage: Nice sorting, {name}! That one belongs there.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Look at the picture again. Do we need it to stay safe and healthy?
screens.doneMessage: All sorted, {name}! Needs keep us safe. Wants are fun extras.

screens.story: Ana wants a kite. It costs 10 coins. She has 6 coins today.
screens.pennyHint: What helps Ana get the kite, {name}?

options.label: Save 4 more coins
options.outcome: Ana saves 4 more coins. Now she has 10, and she buys the kite.

options.label: Spend all 6 coins now
options.outcome: Ana spends her 6 coins today. The kite has to wait a bit longer.

options.label: Buy a balloon today
options.outcome: A balloon is fun! Ana has fewer coins left for the kite.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Saving a little more gets Ana to 10 coins.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The kite costs 10 coins. Spending now leaves Ana fewer coins for it.

screens.prompt: Ana keeps 5 coins in her jar. Tap 5 coins to put them in.
screens.pennyHint: Count them out loud with me, {name}: 1, 2, 3...
screens.rightMessage: 5 coins, {name}! You counted them just right.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Count the coins in the jar again. Ana keeps 5.

screens.title: Nice work, {name}!
screens.message: You sorted, you helped Ana, and you counted. That's a money plan!
